quote.english: One sentence today can make tomorrow's conversation easier.
quote.korean: 오늘의 한 문장이 내일의 대화를 더 쉬게 만들 수 있습니다.

explanation.english: You do not need to master everything at once. A short, useful sentence practiced every day builds confidence for real conversations.

expressions.example: Try to learn one new phrase at a time.
Speaking aloud helps you build confidence.
